messages:
Ravi: heads up, the north lot is basically a shallow pond after that burst pipe. my Civic barely made it through. :sweat_smile:  
Elena: omg carpark? Im not leaving until this dries. anyone else parked on level 2?  
Ben: leve2 flooded. had to park on street. FYI elevator A is out so expect a stair climb if youre coming in.  
Clara: ugh stairs = cardio I didnt sign up for. Facilities, any ETA on elevator?  
FacilitiesBot: Elevator A - OUT OF SERVICE due to water ingress. Maintenance dispatched, ETA ~90 minutes. Please use stairwell B or C.  
TransitBot: BART UPDATE: minor delays northbound due to signal checks near Embarcadero. 10-20m. https://www.bart.gov  
Ravi: also saw Muni reroute on Market, buses taking detour via 5th. give extra time if you ride.  
Elena: is there a dry indoor spot to stash umbrellas? the 3rd floor kitchen is chaos rn.  
Ben: left a towel rack by the 4th floor entrance. also someone left spare umbrellas in lost & found.  
Clara: small mercy: Facilities put out extra mats and a sign "Wet floor ">  
Ravi: free coffee on 5th to boost morale. too early to be grateful for municipal chaos but Ill take it.  
Elena: going to WFH until elevator is back. stairs + soaked pants is not a vibe.  
Ben: if anyone needs a lift from the north lot to the lobby, I have room for two in my truck at 8:45. first come first serve.  
Ravi: saving a spot for @Clara, thanks Ben.  
TransitBot: Ferry advisory - choppy waters, may cause slight delays.  
Clara: quick PSA: watch the stair treads, theyre slippery. Facilities put down anti-slip strips but still.  
FacilitiesBot: Maintenance note: please avoid using elevator A for the next 2 hours. Were routing HVAC and pumping water now. Thanks for patience.  
Elena: hope everyone stays dry. send pics of any flood drama (for future comic relief). :camera_with_flash:  
Ben: will try to document without becoming a soggy meme. heading in now, see yall.
